name: Katsuki Ken
source:
Unemployed youngster who loves coffee. One day, he stumbles upon Milk Milk Coffee shop on Cat Street, and immediately falls in love with the shop's barista at first sight. Impulsive, irritable, and sloppy, but always ready to help.

Favorite coffee: Moka-chan's secret special cold latte.

Specialization: Professional coffee brewing.
